title: Private deployment - ACME weekly sync - 2026-05-25
content:
Weekly sync notes for ACME private deployment (VPC / on-prem) - 2026-05-25

Attendees: Priya Nair (SE), Ethan Walker (Customer Eng), Sofia Martinez (Infra), Jon Park (Security), Maya Patel (Platform), customer reps: Laura Chen, Daniel Ortiz (ACME)

High-level goal this week:
- Finish VPC peering and firewall rule sign-off so we can start full e2e staging run next Tues (2026-06-01).
- Validate KMS/HSM integration for key wraps and sign certs for staging cluster.
- Get image push process stable for on-prem registry (auth + RBAC).

Updates:
- Networking (Sofia): VPC peering request submitted to infra team; route tables look clean. Waiting on ACME network team to approve CIDR exception (ticket raised 05/23). No blocker from cloud side.
- Firewall (Jon): Draft firewall rules posted in Confluence. Need ACME security to confirm port list. Notable missing: port 7002 (internal metrics) - asked customer if they require access.
- KMS (Maya): KMS integration PoC done in dev. HSM test harness is flaky on edge cases (session expiry). Working with vendor to get patch; expect resolution by 05/28.
- Registry + Images (Priya): Signed images built and pushed to internal registry. ACME's air-gapped mirror process needs a checksum verification step added - Jon to provide verification script.
- Monitoring & Logging (Ethan): Fluentd sidecar config ready. Customer asked to confirm retention policy; suggested 30d for staging, 90d for prod.

Open questions / Risks:
- ACME network approval timeline (customer owns) - if they delay > 3 business days we push e2e start by a week.
- HSM sessions flakiness could block production KMS cutover. Contingency: use cloud KMS fallback for initial rollout (requires customer approval).
- Compliance: ACME legal requested additional audit logs for key usage - Jon to scope additional logging and estimate impact.

Decisions made:
- Proceed with staging run on 2026-06-01 conditional on network approval. If approval not in by 05/28, postpone to 2026-06-08.
- Use cloud KMS fallback only as temporary measure; do not ship to prod until HSM tests pass.

Action items (owner - due):
- ACME to confirm VPC peering CIDR exception (Laura Chen - ACME) - due 2026-05-27
- Add checksum verification script for mirror sync; provide example and docs (Jon Park) - due 2026-05-26
- Vendor follow-up on HSM session expiry bug; get patch ETA and plan (Maya Patel) - due 2026-05-28
- Security: finalize firewall port list and post final rules; include justification for metrics port 7002 (Jon Park) - due 2026-05-26
- DevOps: schedule full e2e staging run and dry-run checklist; share runbook (Priya Nair + Ethan Walker) - due 2026-05-29
- Compliance: scope additional key-usage logs and impact to storage/costs (Jon Park) - due 2026-05-28
- Customer: confirm log retention choices for staging/prod (Daniel Ortiz - ACME) - due 2026-05-27

Notes / Prep for next sync:
- If ACME approves network today, Sofia will run connectivity tests and share results by EOD 05/25. Need to capture traceroutes, latency to endpoints, and route table snapshot.
- Priya to prepare a short checklist of smoke tests for the first staging run (latency, gen correctness, KV cache behavior, cold start).
- Ethan to validate monitoring alerts thresholds for OOM, throttling, and token latency; will push alert rules to staging config repo.

Parking lot / lower priority:
- Performance benchmark with quantized model variant - schedule for post-staging (non-blocking).
- RBAC UI walkthrough for ACME SREs - plan separate session next week.

Next meeting: 2026-06-01 09:00 PT (conditional on staging start). If postponed, next sync 2026-06-02 09:00 PT for status check.

Quick raw TODOs (personal scratch):
- Follow up with vendor on HSM (Maya) and cc Jon.
- Draft mail to ACME security with firewall rule rationale (Jon).
- Build smoke-test checklist and get sign-off from customer (Priya + Ethan).
- Keep a short list of fallback steps for KMS switch in runbook.

End notes: informal - still rough. Will convert to more polished runbook after staging run confirmed.
